title: Allahabad High Court judge challenges denial of tax exemption on statutory allowances under new tax regime
description: A sitting judge of the Allahabad High Court has filed a petition before the Court challenging the denial of tax exemption on statutory allowances to him under the new tax regime.A Bench of Justice Saumitra Dayal Singh and Justice Swarupama Chaturvedi today asked the Union government and Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) to respond to the petition moved by Justice Sandeep Jain. The Court listed the matter for further hearing on July 28.Justice Saumitra Dayal Singh and Justice Swarupama Chaturv
